info.title: OpenFundraise Public API
info.description: Tenant-scoped OpenFundraise public API for automation clients and server-to-server integrations.

get.description: Validates the supplied full tenant API key and returns tenant plus API-key metadata.
Public catalog for agents and humans. Returns only active organizations and active campaigns, with exact integer amount constraints and designation ids.

parameters.name: embed_key
parameters.description: Optional 12-character public embed-key prefix. Tenant websites use it to expose only their own active campaigns.

post.description: Creates a pending one-time Stripe donation. Fee coverage defaults off. No upsell, round-up, recurring conversion, or other amount-changing behavior is applied.

200.description: Original intent returned for an idempotent retry.

post.description: Charges exactly the stored exact_total_cents. This operation accepts no amount or fee fields. Retrying a completed intent returns the original receipt.

get.description: Returns tenant-scoped donations with filters and pagination. Completed live donations are returned by default.
Returns one tenant-scoped donation by id.
Returns aggregated tenant supporters ordered by latest donation activity by default.

post.description: Adds an internal or private CRM note to a tenant supporter. The tenant CRM module must be enabled.

get.description: Polling trigger that returns a top-level array of tenant donations. Completed live donations are returned by default.
Polling trigger that returns a top-level array of completed recurring tenant donations.
Polling trigger that returns a top-level array of supporters ordered by latest activity. The trigger id includes supporter id plus activity timestamp.

bearerAuth.description: Full OpenFundraise tenant API key, for example `Authorization: Bearer via_pk_live_...`.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Number of records to return. Defaults to 50 and is capped at 100.

Since.name: since
Since.description: Start of the date window as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

Until.name: until
Until.description: End of the date window as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

DonationStatus.name: status
DonationStatus.description: Donation status filter. Defaults to completed. Use `any` to include all statuses.

IncludeTest.name: include_test
IncludeTest.description: Set to true to include test-mode records. Test records are excluded by default.

IncludeAchPending.name: include_ach_pending
IncludeAchPending.description: For `status=completed`, include ACH donations still pending settlement.

Search.name: search
Search.description: Supporter name or email search text.

Email.name: email
Email.description: Alias for `search`, commonly used by automation clients.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, shortened, invalid, or revoked API key.

Forbidden.description: Tenant is inactive, API key lacks public API access, or a required module is disabled.

AgentApiError.description: Structured error that an agent can safely inspect and recover from.

field.description: Request field the agent should repair, when the error is field-specific.

amount_cents.description: Human-approved charitable amount in minor currency units.

stripe_payment_method.description: Stripe Shared Payment Token (spt_...) scoped by the wallet to this seller and exact approved total. Stripe PaymentMethod ids (pm_...) and single-use tokens (tok_...) are also accepted.

payment.description: UCP payment envelope. Supply this or stripe_payment_method, never both.

cover_fees.description: Set true only when fee coverage was separately and explicitly approved.
